errors.evidence: The line for "Arbeitsvolumen" (work volume) does not fall to 105 in 2021. The lowest point of the dip is in 2020 at a value of approximately 104.5. In 2021, the value had recovered to approximately 106.

errors.evidence: This description oversimplifies the trend for "Jahresarbeitszeit" (annual working time). The chart shows a sharp drop from 2019 to a minimum in 2020, followed by a partial recovery in 2021. Describing this V-shaped event as a single decline between 2019 and 2021 is misleading and misses the key dynamic of the data during that period.
